title: Right-action evaluation of the tensor mate of an arbitrary arrow
statement:
Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories, with bifunctors $\otimes_{\mathcal C}:\mathcal C\times\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ and $\otimes_{\mathcal D}:\mathcal D\times\mathcal D\to\mathcal D$, both denoted $\otimes$. Let $L:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$, $R:\mathcal D\to\mathcal C$ have a specified adjunction $L\dashv R$ with natural unit $\eta:\mathrm{id}\to RL$ and counit $\varepsilon:LR\to\mathrm{id}$ satisfying the triangle identities [lem-weil-pbc-adjunction-of-natural-bijection]. Fix a natural isomorphism $\mu_{M,P}:L(M\otimes P)\xrightarrow{\sim}LM\otimes LP$. For each $K\in\mathcal C$, $E\in\mathcal D$, and morphism $c:LK\to E$, put
$$F_K(P)=K\otimes P,\quad H_E(P)=E\otimes LP,\quad G_E=RH_E,\quad \beta^c_P=(c\otimes1_{LP})\mu_{K,P},\quad \alpha^c_P=R(\beta^c_P)\eta_{K\otimes P}.$$
Fix objects $\mathbf1_{\mathcal C},\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$, natural isomorphisms $\rho^{\mathcal C}_X:X\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\xrightarrow{\sim}X$ and $\rho^{\mathcal D}_Y:Y\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}\xrightarrow{\sim}Y$, and an isomorphism $u:L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathbf1_{\mathcal D}$. Suppose for every $M\in\mathcal C$ that
$$\rho^{\mathcal D}_{LM}(1_{LM}\otimes u)\mu_{M,\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=L(\rho^{\mathcal C}_M).$$
Put $k_E=\rho^{\mathcal D}_E(1_E\otimes u):E\otimes L\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}\to E$. For every $K,E,c:LK\to E$, the following equalities hold:
$$k_E\beta^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=cL(\rho^{\mathcal C}_K),\qquad R(k_E)\alpha^c_{\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}}=R(c)\eta_K\rho^{\mathcal C}_K.$$
The first equality is in $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal D}(L(K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C}),E)$ and the second in $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(K\otimes\mathbf1_{\mathcal C},RE)$. No associator, left unitor, shift, exactness, or monoidal coherence data beyond the displayed right-action equation are assumed.
